x-pmi-mapping: Risk register, PMBOK Guide, Eighth Edition (see ADR-0007). v0.1 covers identification, qualitative assessment and response planning; urgency, proximity, contingency and fallback plans, residual and secondary risks and reserves are deferred.
title: Risk register entry
description: One uncertain event that could affect the group's objectives, negatively (threat) or positively (opportunity). An event that has already happened and was never uncertain is an issue, not a risk. Use only information stated or clearly implied in the artifact; omit any optional field that is not.

title.description: Short label for the risk, about ten words or fewer.

event.description: The uncertain event itself, without its cause or effect. Example: The supplier may deliver the sensors late.

kind.description: threat: would harm objectives if it happens. opportunity: would benefit them.

status.description: open: could still happen. occurred: it has happened. closed: no longer relevant, or the response is complete. Use open for a newly identified risk.

cause.description: The condition or fact that makes the event possible.

effect.description: What would happen to objectives if the event occurs.

probability.description: Likelihood of the event, only if the artifact gives or clearly implies one.

impact.description: Size of the effect if the event occurs, only if the artifact gives or clearly implies one.

owner.description: Person or role responsible for monitoring and responding, as named in the artifact.

category.description: Short category if one is stated or obvious, for example technical, schedule, cost, supplier, people or external.

response_strategy.description: Agreed response. For threats: escalate, avoid, transfer, mitigate or accept. For opportunities: escalate, exploit, share, enhance or accept.

response_actions.description: Specific actions agreed to carry out the response.

triggers.description: Warning signs that the event is about to happen or has happened.
